approval: Owner approved HF uploads for experimentally working models with licenses preserved (2026-10-27). The precision is chosen per dispatch from the recipes below; a recipe with a precision_receipt is refused unless that receipt shows every case token-ID exact.

license_file.note: The model repository declares license: apache-2.0 but ships no LICENSE file (tree at the pinned revision checked 2026-10-28); the verbatim Apache-2.0 text is taken from the upstream code repository at its MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 release commit, the last commit touching LICENSE (byte-identical on main 50b74eba on 2026-10-28).

notice_file.note: Neither the Hub repository nor the code repository at the pinned commit has a NOTICE file (HTTP 404, 2026-10-28), so none is redistributed; the card carries the attribution and statement of changes required by Apache-2.0 section 4.
